_comment: Recall questions for the sessions you replay. A fact is a list of spellings; when several appear in the history, the one that appears last is the expected answer (values that changed mid-session). A question is asked only if every fact appears in the summarized range or the previous summary. `kind` is a short label the proposer sees about a failure; it never sees the answers. A session is holdout when a `holdout` entry is a substring of its title or its file name.

questions.kind: connection steps read from a doc early in the session
